svg.title: MapReduce data flow pipeline
svg.desc: The complete MapReduce job flow from input data through map phase, shuffle and sort, and reduce phase to final output.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the map phase in more detail')
sendPrompt('Why is shuffle and sort needed?')
sendPrompt('What does a reducer do with grouped data?')
sendPrompt('What is a combiner and when should I use one?')
